ns2:course.label: Teach Elem Rdg & Lang Arts I
ns2:course.description: First of a two-course sequence that examines the basic theories, issues, methods, and materials for a developmental K-8 language arts program. Emphasizes the need to integrate the four language arts (reading, writing, speaking , and listening) as tools for learning across the curriculum. Addresses cultural diversity in language arts instruction, with emphasis on linguistic diversity. Prerequisite: CI 467 and admission to the Elementary Teacher Education Program. Elementary Education students register for 3 hours. Special Education students register for 4 hours.
